centralQuestion: Is there any material V1 path on which PlanningProjection, prescribed lines, retracted or superseded evidence, or future evidence can contaminate HistoricalState, or on which History + Projection composes a semantically incoherent prescription?
answer: YES. A: a stale KNOWN row planned from retracted evidence is the adoption reference of a first establishment log when history holds the exercise as FROM_LOG (QE-R7ASC-01). C: after a goal change the reducer (old goal) and the closing review (new goal) resolve the same evidence into different doses, and an unrelated decision switches between them; a regression of this freeze (QE-R7ASC-04). D: in RETURN mode the run gate's HOLD is overwritten, so history credits the return week before its long run exists and despite missing it (QE-R7ASC-03). C on the declared boundary E10: the run outside re-entry plans unearned progression from the projection (QE-R7ASC-02). Property B holds.

findings.class: SAME_CLASS as QE-R7ASM-01 (residual; adjacent state: history holds the exercise as FROM_LOG without a usable load)
findings.summary: asEstablishment converts a KNOWN row only when the start does not hold the exercise. When history holds it as FROM_LOG (established by effort, no usable load), a stale KNOWN row planned from evidence later retracted keeps its value, and loggedLoadDecision takes it as the planned reference, so the first usable log is adopted without D45 confirmation.
path: -> evidenceState -> historicalStateOf / planningBase / stateAtBreak; the closing review's evidenceStart
findings.reproduction: P01: identical record; EARLY (correction before planning) -> FROM_LOG pending 19 (or 24) kg + ESTABLISHMENT_LOG_UNCONFIRMED; LATE (correction after planning, stale KNOWN 22 row) -> KNOWN 19 (or 24) kg LOGGED_ACTUAL, no question; week 4 KNOWN 24 4x5. History at week 3 identical in both cells. P01b: the same with no decision after week 1 (COMPLETED_SESSIONS) and through a conflict (Q3b trigger).
findings.contractClaimFalsified: STATE_CONSUMER_CONTRACT §3: a KNOWN row's load is not the reference a first log is judged against, so that log waits for confirmation (SSCTR D45)

findings.class: NEW_CLASS: two resolvers of EarnedProgress across a goal context change
findings.summary: The evidence reducer judges a week under its own goal context (HistoricalState's EarnedProgress, the PlanningView's dose); the closing weekly review applies the next week's context to the same evidence and writes next week's rows. After a goal change the two disagree, and any later decision that re-composes the week from the PlanningView (e.g. an equipment statement that changes no exercise, KEEP instantiationOnly) re-doses it.
path: src/r6-adaptation.mjs:560/:573 (equipmentChange composeWeeks fromWeek w; KEEP instantiationOnly records the re-composed weeks)
findings.reproduction: P07: every ordered goal pair; GOAL_CHANGE on week 4 Monday (from week 5); week 4 executed and reviewed; EQUIP cell: equipment statement on week 5 Monday. Identical record. 18 of 20 pairs, 71 exercise rows differ: STRENGTH->HYPERTROPHY back-squat 82.5x7 vs 85x5; STRENGTH->MAINTAIN db-bench-press 20x6 vs 22x6; GENERAL->RUNNING_SUPPORT db-row 24x6 vs 22x10; MAINTAIN->HYPERTROPHY back-squat 80x7 vs 80x5; RUNNING_SUPPORT->MAINTAIN back-squat 82.5x6 vs 82.5x8.

findings.class: NEW_CLASS: re-entry run gate overwrites HOLD (order-dependent)
findings.summary: In RETURN/RESTART weeklyGates maps every run role to the EASY key and setGate overwrites role by role (LONG, QUALITY, EASY, WALK_JOG); the strength loop keeps an earlier HOLD, the run loop does not. In a moderate return a missed or pending long run never holds the return; the evidence reducer reads the return week's runs as COMPLETED_SESSIONS as soon as the easy runs are executed.
findings.reproduction: P05/P05b: MODERATE (17 days) reported Thursday 06:00, re-entry this week (Thursday EASY 15, Sunday LONG 20). Sunday missed: reasons record HOLD: LONG, gate EASY: ADVANCE, returnStep 1, next week EASY 30, EASY 30, LONG 45 (= executed cell). Easy run missed instead: HOLD. At Thursday 22:00 (Sunday not due) the public reader gives basis.RUN = COMPLETED_SESSIONS and returnStep 1.

findings.assessment: A material Property C violation by the Founder's own attack list (projection above history; HOLD does not progress). E10 rests on the previous Founder §14 (the projection's freedom) but conflicts with the previous §15 and this mission's §11; precedent QE-R7ASM-03. The conservatism trade-off of reading the run from facts only is Founder-owned.
